name: live-mood
blurb: “Wistful, late night”: minor at 100% confidence, 72 bpm, an all-minor i–iv–v, two long notes a bar.

name: demo-morning
blurb: “Bright and hopeful, a morning walk”: major at 100% confidence, 88 bpm, a 16-bar period rocking between C and F with one motif carried through.

name: demo-fanfare
blurb: “Triumphant, a fanfare”: D major at 100%, 140 bpm; each bar's chord was decided just before its notes, and the tune opens with the fanfare leap A–D–F#.

name: demo-pop-loop
blurb: The four-chord pop loop C G Am F at 120; Jev writes a chorus over it, one arpeggiated motif per chord.
